snippet.title: Flock Off! | Open Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
The sheep are hungry, and you're on the menu.
Get ready for the Flock Off! open playtest!
📅 November 6-16
🐏 Survive the zombie sheepocalypse
 🤾 1-4 players
🔗 Sign up on Steam, more details in the link below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021550/Flock_Off?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_id=nov_playtest
